title: Is the Moon Gold or Grey at Dusk

content.question: What colour is the moon when it first shows over the sea at dusk, and does it change as the light goes?
content.method: I climbed to the telescope on the high rock at dusk, sat beside it and waited for the moon to show over the water. I looked through the glass for a long time, then looked again without it to be sure. I kept my eyes on the same patch of sky and tried to name the colour each time the light changed.
content.result: At first it was pale, nearly white, with a little yellow at the edge. Later it looked more grey-gold, which I think is the sky's fault and not the moon's. The glass made it look smaller and cleaner than my eyes did. I am not certain which of the two I trust. I will look again tomorrow, from the same rock, and sit closer to the telescope so it cannot be moved.
